issues.issue: Did the Federal Court apply the correct evidentiary standard and burden of proof regarding infringement?
issues.applicant_position: Federal Court imposed wrong evidentiary standard; Teva had initial burden to put non-infringement in play.
issues.result_text: Federal Court applied correct standard; no error.

issues.issue: Should an adverse inference have been drawn against Teva for not producing tablets?
issues.applicant_position: Adverse inference should be drawn against Teva for not producing tablets.
issues.result_text: No palpable and overriding error on adverse inference.
